purpose: DWP Stat-Xplore, Households on Universal Credit in Great Britain by limited capability for work entitlement group and payment indicator, January to December 2025: the LCWRA group's paid and nil-award cells, whose paid cells the bound dwp.uc.households_lcwra_element row averages (microcosm#1095, B3 of the November event-data plan's PR3). Consumed by the uc_take_up stage's LCWRA fit, which takes the mean over the twelve months of the paid count as the LCWRA households its second odds ratio aims at on the spine's design weights (María's choices of 2026-11-11). No value is derived here.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
